I did some fiddling around with the server and hmr socket for v2
The Server was fairly straightforward and should work pretty much entirely now.

HMR on the other hand is probably gonna need a lot of tweaking due to how assets work in Parcel 2?

I could probably use some guidance on how to do this with the asset graph as it probably needs some kind of diff between previous state and new state, which is not available atm afaik?
I currently implemented some kind of state on hmrServer which gets pushed to the client on `buildEnd` which is just a new event I added to AssetGraphBuilder. It doesn't seem to me like the proper way to do this.

I also added a helper function for normalising cli options, I think this will simplify using these options in multiple places a little?

Closes #2144

issue_context.title: Parcel 2: Server
issue_context.body: The Server from Parcel 1 should be extracted into a separate package in the monorepo for Parcel 2, as `@parcel/server`. This should include both the dev web server as well as the HMR web socket server. All utils related only to servers should be moved into this package. Parcel 1 should also be updated to use this package.

review_comments: I kinda liked doing this normalization in the individual places rather than all in one place... What do you think? Why did you move them here?

I moved it because it could be used in more than one place and seemed better to normalise them in one place only instead of at all places that use it.

for example the generated certificate uses the cacheDir and isn't part of the cache module
